utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help on Saturday. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — could you come by at 9 in the morning on the front porch? I’m still lining up a few more helpers, too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. We still need a few more hands at the front porch on Saturday, so any time you can give would help.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’d really appreciate it. Could you come by around 9 on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I can be there at 9 on Saturday morning at the front porch. I’ll help get the repair drive set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. I can help out for a bit if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that would be wonderful, Oren—thank you! I still need a few helpers, so I’d really appreciate you coming by for a bit on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I be there on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — could you be there at 10 a.m.? I’ll have everything ready on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still looking for a few helpers for the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. If you can lend a hand for a bit, I’d really appreciate it!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — I’m in, and I’ll keep asking a couple of neighbors too for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Saturday would help a lot—could you come by the front porch around 10? I’m still trying to keep the logistics simple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can be there around 10 at the front porch and help for a bit. Just point me to whatever needs doing first.
